$comment: A8 · the initiative register (hand-curated). Every entry is a real, public initiative of the Capital Market, Insurance and Savings Authority or the Ministry of Finance, read from the regulator's own document (sources[].url, the page the fact is on, the retrieval date). Nothing here is inferred: a date or a parameter the document does not print is left out. The modelled shock is a labelled assumption (src = 'assumption') unless the document prints it (src = 'source'). pipeline/build_regulation.py turns each entry into a shock per manager x product through the A1 driver files and writes web/public/data/regulation/impact.json.

weights.$comment: assumption: the probability that an initiative takes effect, by its stage, used only to weight the exposure to the whole pipeline. An initiative in force is already inside the LTM base of the driver files, so it adds nothing incremental (weight 0); its row shows what the rule is worth a year.
